method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading, formula/macro/reference comparison and reverse paraphrase with checked terminology; not independent or human review.
scope: All seventeen translated blocks in Dedekind Algebras, including the successor conditions, generated closure lemma and Dedekind-algebra theorem.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The natural numbers must support algebraic operations. Dedekind takes successor as basic: zero is outside its range, successor is injective, and every number is reached from zero by iteration. The third condition is recast as minimal closure because first-order logic alone cannot express repeated application.
samples.checks: All three numbered clauses, two i.e. formulas per first clauses, the repeated-application label/reference, first-order limitation and set-theoretic reformulation are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The f-closure generated by o is the intersection of all f-closed sets containing o. It contains o, is f-closed, and is included in every other such set; the proof checks these properties through intersection membership.
samples.checks: The quantified closure formula, intersection abstraction, all three lemma labels, range-union witness, and inclusion argument are exact. MRINF-002 records the implicit ambient endofunction assumption without changing formulas.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A Dedekind algebra is a triple (A,f,o) with an injective endofunction omitting o and with A generated by o. Every such algebra is Dedekind infinite. Conversely an injective non-surjective self-map g on D restricts to the g-closure of an omitted point, yielding a Dedekind algebra.
samples.checks: All definition clauses, theorem implication, restriction formula, range inclusions, injection inheritance and both closure inclusions are preserved with their references.

source_observations.finding: The closure lemma leaves its ambient carrier A and endofunction assumption implicit.
source_observations.resolution: The target preserves the formal text and records the assumption because the theorem's actual uses provide the needed endofunctions.

limitations: No independent linguistic, mathematical or historical review has been performed.
